definitions.explanation: To maintain an action or state without stopping. Can be used as a main verb or as an auxiliary verb attached to other verb stems.

examples.japanese: {勉強|べんきょう}を{続|つづ}ける。
{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.notes: Auxiliary usage: verb stem + {続|つづ}ける

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けることが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: It's important to continue making effort.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しくても{毎日|まいにち}{日本語|にほんご}の{勉強|べんきょう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: Even though I'm busy, I continue studying Japanese every day.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{一度|いちど}も{休|やす}まずに10{年間|ねんかん}ピアノを{弾|ひ}き{続|つづ}けて、プロの{演奏家|えんそうか}になった。
examples.english: She kept playing piano for 10 years without taking a single break, and became a professional musician.
examples.notes: Auxiliary usage: {弾|ひ}き{続|つづ}ける = keep playing

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {続|つづ}く (intransitive, to continue). Pattern: Xを{続|つづ}ける (continue X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {続|つづ}けている = 'has been continuing.'

MAIN VERB PATTERNS:
・{仕事|しごと}を{続|つづ}ける (continue work)
・{勉強|べんきょう}を{続|つづ}ける (continue studying)
・{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}ける (continue making effort)

AUXILIARY VERB USAGE (very common):
Attach to verb stem (masu-stem) to mean 'keep ~ing':
・{食|た}べ{続|つづ}ける (keep eating)
・{走|はし}り{続|つづ}ける (keep running)
・{考|かんが}え{続|つづ}ける (keep thinking)

CONTRAST:
・{続|つづ}ける (transitive): continue X / keep doing
・{続|つづ}く (intransitive): X continues
